project.name: imagegen
project.description:
Master-Roadmap-2026.md item #3 (image generation, Flux/GPT-Image) - a new sibling module, same shape as "sarvam"/"google": a genuinely new capability with its own entity/service/controller/tool-callback surface, not bolted onto an existing module (see core/pom.xml's header comment for the "modular monolith" reasoning this repeats every time).
Stage 1 (this module's only contents so far): OpenAI's Images API (gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3, https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations) via a plain RestClient call - the same "no dedicated Spring AI starter, call the REST endpoint directly" shape OpenRouterAgentChatClientFactory/ GrokAgentChatClientFactory use for chat, applied here to image generation instead. Flux (via Replicate/fal.ai or similar) is a later addition, not Stage 1 - OPENAI is already a fully wired BYOK ProviderName (see OpenAIProviderValidator), so it needs zero new credential-storage plumbing: the OpenAI API key a tenant already activated for chat is reused here via ProviderCredentialResolver#resolveActiveKey(ProviderName.OPENAI).
Depends on: providers (ProviderCredentialResolver/ProviderName - reused OpenAI BYOK key, no new credential table, unlike Sarvam's SARVAM branch which needed one because Sarvam's key isn't in LlmProviderCredential; OpenAI's already is). storage (FileStorageService - generated PNG/WebP bytes are stored the same S3-compatible way SarvamGeneratedAudioService stores synthesized WAV clips - see that class's javadoc for why: a tool result can only return a JSON reference, never raw binary, so the bytes always land in object storage first and get served back through this module's own authenticated controller endpoint). No cycle: neither providers nor storage depends on imagegen.
